title: Keep the encountered-image quantifier and fixed accuracy scale
statement: For actual failed-check task images within eta of an UNKNOWN r-dimensional S and eta+sigma<=g/2, R<=min(n,r max[4,2+4log2((L+sigma)/g)]) for every finite prefix, hence an arbitrarily long adaptive task stream at fixed epsilon/mu. r/S/eta are complexity parameters,not given basis/advice. A shared primitive range approximation is stronger sufficient data; generic full-rank tails may qualify. The determinant/width step is established reduced-basis machinery and does not infer all directions have been learned after the last observed update. Correct accepted answers remain valid without low width; useful enrichment bound may then fail. Rank-n/2 projector has tiny exact algebra but large image width,so this service does not uniformly supersede the exact-algebra trace compiler. Finer later epsilon/mu requires paid recalibration/enrichment.

Later adaptive A(theta)=alpha I+sum theta_j B_j has real sum|theta_j|<=1 and known A>=mu I; mu is supplied/earned from the input class, not inferred from a small compression.

Adaptive tasks and arbitrary correlated/history-dependent action errors are allowed under that contract. Fixed accuracy/width conditions, precision, full-vector preparation/output, cache/storage/local solves and actual downstream work remain charged. Actual core collaborator reviews retain their communicated subject and repairs, not eventual software/all extensions/novelty/superiority. costs: At T tasks/R enrichments, explicit doubling/refresh schedule Q<=k(T+4R) primitive actions. Every failed solve and changing temporary load direction is included. Some already-contained tasks can cost zero new actions.
Column tolerance scales as sigma/sqrt(cache capacity); declared price delta^-p gives O_p(k sigma^-p[(R+1)^(1+p/2)+T(R+1)^(p/2)]). This is a proxy, not time/energy/sample count.
Storage O(knR), full-vector projections/output and reduced dense solves/QR paid. Squared Hermitian primitives use two original actions with propagated errors/preparation paid.
